title: Freshness rule follow-ups: clock cases for every decisive time, Reason serialized as its code, `now` read after collect, and a target-set race in the collector
outcome: Freshness rule follow-ups: clock cases for every decisive time, Reason serialized as its code, `now` read after collect, and a target-set race in the collector
acceptance: A collector read that meets a configuration and a state of different identities, as during `target set`, reads the pair again once before it reports backup_record_unreadable, and a test covers it
A serialized freshness reason is its backup_* code, and a test pins the serialized form to Reason::code

The clock-invalid test puts the only future time in observed_equal_at, last_confirmation, the newest receipt's time and capture start, last_attempt.started_at and each configuration statement, and each reads backup_clock_invalid
The status and doctor readers take the clock after collecting the records, or collect returns the instant to use, and the freshness module documents the order
